sermons.title: Sermon 2014 | As We Have Heard, So Have We Seen

scripture.verse: "As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the Lord of Hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it forever."

sermons.title: Sermon 2016 | Jesus Affirmed To Be Alive

scripture.verse: "Against whom when the accusers stood up, they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed: but had certain questions against him of their own superstition and of one Jesus, which was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive."

"And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any, came behind Him and touched the border of His garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched."

sermons.title: Sermon 2020 | Is Anything Too Hard for the Lord?

scripture.verse: "Then came the word of the Lord unto Jeremiah, saying, Behold, I am the Lord, the God of all flesh: is there anything too hard for Me?"

sermons.title: Sermon 2021 | Nathanael—Or, the Ready Believer and His Reward

scripture.verse: "Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto you, I saw you under the fig tree, you believe? You shall see greater things than these."

sermons.title: Sermon 2022 | The Wedding Was Furnished with Guests
